frozen_order_family.rule: exact R25 order: prefix [35,1,32,2,37,69,59,23], then original R18 remainder preserving relative order
original R18 order with [35,1,32,2,37,69,59,23] removed, then append those eight in the frozen R24 order
exact R23 MIN_FILL_INTERNAL elimination_order on the original frozen W05 primal graph
exact R23 MIN_DEGREE_INTERNAL elimination_order on the original frozen W05 primal graph
reverse the complete exact R23 MIN_FILL_INTERNAL order
reverse the complete exact R23 MIN_DEGREE_INTERNAL order
sort original internal variables by descending degree in the original frozen primal graph, tie by ascending variable id

order_coverage_gate: every order contains every original internal variable exactly once and no bridge variable

control_requirements.ORIGINAL_R18_OCCURRENCE: must use the exact sealed R18 order and preserve resource-OPEN semantics if nonterminal
control_requirements.R24_CUTSET_FIRST: must use the exact sealed R25 order and preserve resource-OPEN semantics if nonterminal

survivor_definition: ORDER_SURVIVOR iff the exact frozen R18 machine completes all 60 original-internal existential quantifications, returns COMPLETE_INTERFACE_DAG, and final support is a subset of the frozen bridge under the unchanged per-order resource envelope.
survivor_resource_ranking: Among terminal survivors only: maximum_nodes_seen_before_gc, then nodes_created_total, then restrict_calls_total, then order id. Nonterminal lanes are not ranked by wall-time progress.
promotion_rule: R26 never reads semantic truth. If a terminal survivor exists, a later gate must byte-freeze one resource-selected survivor before any post-terminal semantic verification. If no survivor exists, do not add a ninth order post hoc; move to a new representation/composition operator hypothesis.
claim_ceiling: Finite exposed-world order sensitivity for one frozen Shannon-DAG machine only. No optimal-order theorem, polynomial runtime claim, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP conclusion.
